scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @wakeops/web" "npm run dev -w @wakeops/api" "npm run dev -w @wakeops/workers"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @wakeops/shared && npm run build -w @wakeops/database && npm run build -w @wakeops/alerts && npm run build -w @wakeops/integrations && npm run build -w @wakeops/incidents && npm run build -w @wakeops/telephony && npm run build -w @wakeops/notifications && npm run build -w @wakeops/workflows && npm run build -w @wakeops/api && npm run build -w @wakeops/workers && npm run build -w @wakeops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:actions
